---
title: "Grafikon iz Excela"
format: docx
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

file = "Grafikoni.xlsx"

df = pd.read_excel(
    file,
    sheet_name="grafCone",
    usecols="A:E"
)

df = df.dropna(subset=["TestIme"])

# %
df["Skupaj"] = df["Zdravo"] + df["Mejno"] + df["Tvegano"]

df["Zdravo_pct"] = df["Zdravo"] / df["Skupaj"] * 100
df["Mejno_pct"] = df["Mejno"] / df["Skupaj"] * 100
df["Tvegano_pct"] = df["Tvegano"] / df["Skupaj"] * 100

x = np.arange(len(df))
width = 0.6  

plt.figure(figsize=(16, 6))

plt.bar(x, df["Zdravo_pct"], width=width, label="Zdravo")
plt.bar(x, df["Mejno_pct"], width=width,
        bottom=df["Zdravo_pct"], label="Mejno")
plt.bar(x, df["Tvegano_pct"], width=width,
        bottom=df["Zdravo_pct"] + df["Mejno_pct"],
        label="Tvegano")

plt.xticks(x, df["TestIme"], rotation=45, ha='right')

plt.ylabel("Procent (%)")
plt.ylim(0, 100)


plt.legend(
    loc="upper center",
    bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 1.15),
    ncol=3
)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
